about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: Computer Science graduate working as a Full-Stack Developer and AI Engineer with experience in tech startups — from microservices architecture and direct LLM API integrations to cloud deployment of production systems.
about.paragraph2: Proven track record in Back-end (Python, Django, Node.js), Front-end (Vue.js) and Blockchain (Solidity), with a solid foundation in DevOps, RESTful APIs and both relational and non-relational databases. Impact-driven profile: I identify architectural bottlenecks, propose solutions and deliver measurable results in high-responsibility, lean-team environments.
about.spec1_desc: Implementing hybrid architectures and smart contracts on Polygon L2 to ensure data immutability.
about.spec2_desc: Building scalable RESTful APIs using Python (Django/FastAPI) and Node.js with a focus on performance.
about.spec3_desc: Developing modern interfaces with Vue.js integrated into containerized systems using Docker.
about.spec4_desc: Using LLMs and Prompt Engineering for code optimization, documentation, and process automation.

research.title: Research & Experience
research.subtitle: Technological Initiation Experience at UESC
research.project_tcc_title: Final Project: Animal Traceability with Blockchain
research.project_tcc_desc: Full-stack platform architecture to solve agribusiness fraud through immutable traceability. Implementation of a hybrid architecture (on-chain/off-chain) recording event hashes on the Polygon network (L2) and developing a back-end custodial wallet to abstract Web3 complexity.
research.project1_desc: Development of a Python system for 3D image capture using Intel RealSense sensors and complex metadata storage. The solution automated data collection for future regression models.
research.project2_desc: Creation of a Python desktop application for automating national nutritional formulas. Rigorous application of OOP concepts and numerical processing with NumPy.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: Professional journey focused on building scalable products and driving innovation within startup ecosystems

datafly.stack: NestJS, Next.js, Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Prisma, Supabase, WhatsApp Business API (official/unofficial), FastAPI, Vue.js, JWT, Docker, Web Scraping, LLMs, Microservices Architecture
highlights: Proposed and architected the AI module (lexa-ai) from scratch as an independent microservice, decoupling the AI from the monolithic CRM — an isolated, reusable and horizontally scalable service

Cut AI response time from up to 12 minutes down to 3 at most (~75% reduction) by redesigning the message processing architecture, replacing the coupled legacy flow with an efficient asynchronous pipeline
Designed and built a web scraping system for automated lookup of lawsuits across Brazilian court systems, feeding the AI agents with up-to-date data
Designed and built an infrastructure layer to manage and monitor all platform services, increasing operational visibility and streamlining deployments
Works full-stack across the product — from LLM orchestration and WhatsApp Business API integration to building CRM interfaces in Next.js

dria.stack: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, Conversational AI Platforms, WhatsApp Business API, CRM
highlights: Managed an active portfolio of simultaneous clients (doctors and clinics), leading the complete onboarding cycle — from first contact to AI agent activation in production
Achieved the fastest activation time in the team since joining, in a process that took months
Won an internal reactivation campaign, outperforming the entire team — awarded paid time off
Identified a gap in the onboarding experience and, on own initiative, created support materials that reduced friction in the adoption process
Documented the area's processes from scratch in internal documents adopted by management, still in use after departure

brco_v2.stack: Node.js, Express.js, Prisma, Vue.js, Pinia, Docker, AWS Lightsail, Netlify

Built a secure RESTful API with Node.js/Express.js and Prisma ORM, implementing CSV report export functionality.
Production deployment of the application with a containerized back-end (Docker on AWS Lightsail) and front-end distributed via Netlify.

brco_v1.stack: Django, Vue.js, JWT, Pytest, Docker, AWS EC2
highlights: Implemented v1 of the nutritional platform (Django/Vue.js) with JWT authentication and test suite (Pytest)
PDF report generation, Docker Compose containerization and deployment on AWS EC2
